description:
The live ruleset v-tag-restricted (18774756) has only a creation rule (verified 2026-10-17 via gh api). It does not block update or deletion of refs/tags/v*. docs/internal/adr/adr-dev-loop-v2.md:192 says it prevents creation or mutation, and docs/internal/release-artifacts.md says the tag ruleset is what forbids moves. A moved tag would point a release at a different commit than the one that was tested.

Resolution (2026-10-17 adversarial review, both reviewers): do both halves; neither alone is sufficient.
- Owner settings change: add update and delete rules to v-tag-restricted. This is an owner action; agents share the owner account (ADR D4) and the ruleset bypass actor is that same user, so record honestly that this binds other collaborators and future automation, not the agent account itself (claude NEW-3).
- Workflow control (the machine gate that actually binds): release-v2 re-checks the tag object and peeled commit in the publishing job after approval (owned by dlv2-51). This item does not close on the ruleset change alone.
- Drift recording: extend the shared predicate in _project/scripts/ruleset_review_enforcement.py (tag_protection_findings currently accepts creation-only at :135-147) so creation-only fixtures fail, and record the chosen rule set in scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py so drift is caught (codex F9(2)).
